title: Differentials in a formally etale tower
statement: Let $R\to A\to B$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, with the $R$-algebra structure on $B$ given by composition. Write $\Omega_{A/R}$, $\Omega_{B/R}$ and $\Omega_{B/A}$ for the modules of Kahler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], and $H_1(L_{B/A})$ for the first homology of the naive cotangent complex [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Suppose $\Omega_{B/A}=0$ and $H_1(L_{B/A})=0$ (the cotangent-module formulation of formal etaleness). Then the canonical $B$-linear map $B\otimes_A\Omega_{A/R}\longrightarrow\Omega_{B/R}$, $b\otimes\mathrm da\longmapsto b\,\mathrm d(a|_B)$, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0H93, lemma-formally-etale-omega, final assertion, stated using the equivalent cotangent-module formulation of its hypothesis. Mathlib/RingTheory/Etale/Basic.lean:42--49 defines precisely the two zero-module conditions; Mathlib/RingTheory/Etale/Kaehler.lean:38--45 supplies the canonical equivalence.
